title: Ikea Hemnes bedside shelf
author: AaronDesigns
description:
I wanted a bedside shelf because stuff kept falling of the ledge of the bed. But i didn't feel like using just a flat piece of wood. So i created this shelf with a raised edge so stuff wouldn't roll or slide off it. There's also a little slit for a charger cable to always hang in place so it can't slip off. The indent is for mugs so they won't slide all over, but you could also put a liner in there as a sort of coaster.

The brackets i used are _**not**_ created by me. They are created by Bushman. Below is a link to his brackets.

https://makerworld.com/en/models/2240556-hemnes-side-shelf-no-drilling-into-the-bed#profileId-2438797

I had some fitment issues, so i also created a few spacers you can glue on if you have the same issue.

I've used it daily for a few weeks now and can't believe i waited this long to make this. In those weeks i've put large cola bottles on there and even mugs with hot tea, it doesn't even flinch.

IKEA hemnes bed bed accesory bedside shelf
